actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Seed of the environment's random generator
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

inputs.description: Seed used by the next reset
inputs.name: seed

facts.text: ManiSkill is the simulation platform named by the repository
The table_scene module imports BaseEnv from mani_skill.envs.sapien_env
TableEnv subclasses ManiSkill's BaseEnv
TableSetting subclasses TableEnv
BlocksStackEasyEnv subclasses TableSetting
blocks_stack_easy is registered with max_episode_steps=200
The task adds two cube objects, one per object id
The success test compares cube 0 with [-0.3, 0, 0.02] and cube 1 with [-0.3, 0, 0.06] using eps [0.03, 0.03, 0.01]
TableSetting.reset takes seed and options and returns the (observation, info) tuple of BaseEnv.reset
TableSetting.step records the action and forwards it to BaseEnv.step
The run configuration selects env_id blocks_stack_easy, control_mode pd_joint_pos, num_envs 1, env_seed 0 and random_scene true
The H1_2 upper body has 14 arm joints and the inspire hand has 24 finger joints
The arm and finger controllers are PDJointPosControllerConfig with lower=None, upper=None and normalize_action=False, combined in the pd_joint_pos controller
The table environment's simulation config sets control_freq=100
The run loop creates the environment with gym.make(env_id)
The run loop reads the robot's first 38 joint positions and passes them to env.step
TableSetting.evaluate returns an empty dict
compute_dense_reward returns 1 and compute_normalized_dense_reward returns that value divided by 10
The default sensor configuration adds a base_camera at 512 by 512 pixels
The H1_2 URDF is loaded from the assets directory of the clone
The repository asks the user to download assets.zip and table_assets.zip into the assets directories
The pinned ManiSkill dependency is mani_skill==3.0.0b21
The codebase is under CC BY-NC 4.0

determinism.notes: the fake seeds its initial joint-position jitter from reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 and its transitions are deterministic; upstream scene randomization uses get_random_pose and ManiSkill's random generator, so the two streams are not the same

gaps: no rigid-body simulation: SAPIEN integration, contacts, friction, gravity, the H1_2 robot, the table scene and the two cubes are not modelled; the fake stores and echoes the 38 commanded joint positions
observation surrogate: the fake returns 38 joint positions, while the environment's state observation (obs_mode null) and the 512 by 512 base_camera image are not reproduced (table_scene.py:278)

success and termination: TableSetting.evaluate returns an empty dict (table_scene.py:1398-1399); the fake models only the registered 200-step episode limit and does not evaluate the cube placement success test
reward: the fake returns 0.0; compute_normalized_dense_reward returns 0.1 under the normalized_dense reward mode (table_scene.py:1408-1414), while the run configuration leaves reward_mode null

action envelope: the upstream controllers take joint limits from the robot model in the external assets, so the package declares no sourced bound; the fake's 38-element Box is unbounded and no Limit is declared
seeding is partial: the fake draws its initial jitter with Python random.Random, not with the ManiSkill random generator or get_random_pose
no assets, GPU, SAPIEN or ManiSkill are installed here, so the sim backend (gymnasium.make of the registered env_id) was not run
no rendering and no snapshot or restore: the fake exposes no get_state/set_state pair

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: after an e-stop the bridge accepts neither step nor reset until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the last observation stays readable
